qa_pairs.question: What chapter number covers Engine Electrical Equipment?
Which BMW models are covered in this Engine Electrical Equipment section?
qa_pairs.answer: Models 325, 325e, 325es, 325i, and M3 are covered in this section.

qa_pairs.question: On which page can I find information about DME troubleshooting test procedures?
qa_pairs.answer: DME troubleshooting test procedures can be found on page 12-111.

qa_pairs.question: What page contains the engine electric layout for M3 models?
qa_pairs.answer: The engine electric layout for M3 models is on page 12-106.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I find information about the 55-pin plug connections?
qa_pairs.answer: Information about 55-pin plug connections can be found on page 12-107/3.

qa_pairs.question: Which page covers the fuel supply system information?
qa_pairs.answer: Fuel supply system information is covered on page 12-114/1.
